name: releases
description: Search changelogs and look up release notes in the Release Notes Index, plus the skills for listing your product on it and the operator skills for running and maintaining the registry. Grouping mirrors skills.sh.json so the skills.sh page and the `npx skills add` picker agree.

plugins.name: releases
plugins.description: Search changelogs and look up releases via the hosted Release Notes Index. Bundles the hosted MCP connection, the /releases lookup command, and auto-triggering skills for release/changelog questions.

plugins.name: listing
plugins.description: Owner-facing: discover where you publish release notes and write a valid releases.json manifest to list your product on Releases Index.

plugins.name: onboarding-parsing
plugins.description: Managed-agent skills for onboarding changelog sources and driving the fetch/parse pipeline.

plugins.name: registry-maintenance
plugins.description: Operator skills for maintaining the registry — ingest, backfills, overviews, release content, playbooks, coverage. Most need an admin API key.
